lmek001.name: Iron Striker
lmek001.description: A durable frontline skirmisher, designed to withstand heavy fire while delivering precise counterattacks.
lmek001.appearance: A bulky mech with reinforced armor plating. It features a sturdy frame with angular armor plates, giving it a rugged and battle-hardened look. Material color is steel gray with red accents.

lmek002.name: Shadow Phantom
lmek002.description: A nimble infiltrator, utilizing high mobility and evasive tactics to strike from the shadows and disappear.
lmek002.appearance: A sleek and agile mech with a streamlined design. It has a dark, matte black finish with glowing blue accents. The mech's limbs are slender and flexible, allowing for swift movements and quick strikes.

lmek003.name: Specter Shadow
lmek003.description: A stealth-oriented combat unit with enhanced shielding, excelling in rapid ambushes and energy-based assaults.
lmek003.appearance: A shadowy mech with a mysterious aura, featuring darkened plating and adaptive camouflage. The Specter Shadow is equipped with advanced stealth systems and a high-capacity energy weapon for devastating surprise attacks.

lmek004.name: Storm Dancer
lmek004.description: A lightning-fast skirmisher designed for hit-and-run tactics.
lmek004.appearance: A nimble mech with a streamlined design and a vibrant color scheme. It features a sleek frame with integrated thrusters and a high-speed propulsion system. The Storm Dancer is equipped with a rapid-fire energy weapon and a close-quarters combat blade, making it effective in both ranged and melee engagements.
